items.quote: The differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) measurements were carried out in a heat-flux cylindrical Calvet-type calorimetric system Multi HTC 96 (Setaram, Caluire, France). The equipment was calibrated using pure Ag (99.998%), Al (99.999%) and Pb (99.999%) in Al2O3 crucible with Al2O3 lid. The same crucible type was also used for the samples. Helium, at a flow rate of 2 l/h, was used as the analysis chamber gas.
For sample #2, with a mass of 165.3 mg prepared from the smaller ingot, we measured two thermal cycles between 710 °C and 550 °C, both taken at +1 K/min and  1 K/min.

A simple chemical analysis of the heat treated ingots by spark spectrometry (Spectromaxx, Fa. Spectro), indicated at least 0.8 wt.% Sr (the upper calibration limit of that equipment), which is consistent with the nominal composition of 1 wt.% Sr.
Site-specific sample preparation for atom probe tomography (APT) [18] and scanning electron microscope (SEM) imaging were accomplished in a dual-beam FIB/SEM (Helios NanoLab 600TM, FEI Company).
